_comment: Slippi upstream sources, fetched on demand by tools/slippi/fetch.sh into
extern/slippi/ (gitignored). Nothing here is compiled into melee-pc.
They are reference material: slippi-wiki carries SPEC.md, the .slp file
format documentation that src/port/slippi/ implements, and
slippi-ssbm-asm carries the game-side injections whose field-by-field
reads pin down *which* game variable each documented field comes from.
Ishiiruka is the emulator side -- the EXI device, the matchmaking client
and the rollback savestate list -- which is what online play would have
Licences differ from this repository's: slippi-ssbm-asm is GPL-3 and
Ishiiruka is GPL-2. src/port/slippi/ is written against the published
format documentation, not copied from either, and neither is linked.

repos.name: slippi-ssbm-asm
repos.why: Recording/*.asm: which game variable each .slp field reads

repos.name: Ishiiruka
repos.why: Slippi Dolphin: EXI device, matchmaking, rollback savestates
